name: SaunaLife G6 5-Person Outdoor Cabin Sauna
description: Introducing the SaunaLife Model G6 Outdoor Sauna - Experience Luxury and Wellness in Your Own Backyard! Elevate your outdoor living space with the SaunaLife Model G6 Outdoor Sauna. This exquisite sauna combines the finest craftsmanship with modern design, offering a luxurious and immersive sauna experience right at your doorstep. Designed for outdoor environments, the SaunaLife Model G6 is built to withstand the elements, allowing you to enjoy the benefits of sauna therapy year-round. Its durable construction and weather-resistant materials ensure longevity and performance, while the spacious interior provides ample room for relaxation and rejuvenation. Create unforgettable memories and embrace the art of relaxation with the SaunaLife Model G6 Outdoor Sauna. Discover the ultimate sanctuary for wellness, where luxury meets nature. Elevate your outdoor living space and redefine your well-being with the unrivaled beauty and functionality of the SaunaLife Model G6. Model G6 Fully Assembled Outdoor Sauna Environment The SaunaLife GARDEN-Series Model G6 is a completely assembled outdoor home s auna cabin that represents the pinnacle of quality and luxury. This is not a kit! Spacious and comfortable The 5-person Model G6 is a luxurious outdoor home sauna made with premium materials for incredible warmth, beauty, and bather comfort. The satin-smooth, furniture-quality alder interior features two-tier benches for optimal bathing comfort and versatility. The generous interior is showcased by a full-wall, dual-pane, insulated picture window on the front of the sauna, letting bathers enjoy a peerless view of the outdoors. The side entry door also features full-height, dual-pane insulated glass for unmatched ambiance. From floor to ceiling, this sauna is designed to coddle the bather. Impressively robust construction From any angle, it is apparent that this sauna was built without compromise. Its finely sawn, painted spruce exterior beautifully contrasts the rich alder interior. Insulated walls and double-glazed insulated glass ensure maximum thermal efficiency. A rainwater system protects the Model G6 from the elements. This is a serious sauna, built for a lifetime of personal health and wellness. Precision-engineered and crafted The Model G6 sauna was designed by true sauna enthusiasts to create a complete, ready-to-use backyard sauna with impeccable attention to detail. The Model G6 is hand-crafted in Northern Europe, where sauna bathing is a daily health ritual for millions. Its insulated glass door with its beautiful black wood frame is accented by a professional-quality black aluminum door handle. The interior is constructed with no visible fasteners for a professional, finished look and feel. The Model G6 impresses at any angle. Beautifully illuminated The calming beauty of the natural wood adds a layer of serenity to your sauna experience, and the soft illumination from indirect LED lighting will elevate this effect. The Model G6 includes a low-voltage, waterproof white LED lighting system that uses app-based Wi-Fi, allowing you to set the perfect ambiance. A hand-held remote control is also provided for on/off/dim operation. This heat and water-certified (IP67), SaunaLife features dotless LEDs for a modern, upscale appearance. Timeless beauty Form meets function with the SaunaLife G6. This handsome sauna will complement any style home with its classical lines and simple elegance. Every detail of this sauna cabin exudes quality craftsmanship and thoughtful design. Enjoy a lifetime of wellness in your own backyard and Live the SaunaLife!
